title: tanacetum scopulorum
intro: Tanacetum scopulorum, commonly known as Mountain Tansy, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the mountainous regions of western North America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tansy are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as costunolide and dehydrocostus lactone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
